notes.title: Bunnyrama Patch 81-85 released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Thank you for your patience and reports, there is no good excuse for such a long delay. This patch finally fixes Steam achievements on Windows (r85) and Mac (r81). Linux version will follow.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27140659/db00d0006f3bb5cfc58c034882f52d6c0bcf6b3e.png[/img]

notes.title: Dwarflings released from Early Access
notes.content:
This is not related to Bunnyrama, but we are really happy to announce that we just released Dwarflings from Early Access! The game is fast paced puzzle adventure, where you will help a group of dwarves to scape from orcish caves.

Please check it on Steam! [b]Launch discount is 40% (and even more in our 3-in-1 Bundle)[/b], so don't miss it if you like such games!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/562330

Thanks for following, we really appreciate your support!
Starwind Games Team

Hope you will enjoy it!
